== Biography ==
Mary Glasgow is the Livingston parish child baptised on 29 June 1783 to [[Glasgow-1382|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Davidson-14073|Christian (Christine) Davidson]], as named in the held companion indexes.<ref name="LivingstonMary1783">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', Mary Glasgow, baptism 29 June 1783, Livingston, parents Thomas Glasgow and Christian Davidson; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685840887&tab=this R_685840887] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_692403782&tab=this R_692403782], inspected derivatives retained from 29 October 2026; one baptism, original register uninspected.</ref> Her existing approximate birth about 1783 is retained; a baptism day is not an established birthday. Her existing father is assessed at 97% confident for this recorded-child relationship, separately from any later adult identification or her father's ancestry.

Related derivatives give different event details: OPR 669/1 item 4 names Mary, born 18 May 1783 at Blackburn, with baptism 29 June 1784; Whitburn companions give baptism 6 July 1783 to the same parental couple.<ref name="MaryVariants">Findmypast, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4152265&tab=this SCOT/OPR/BAP/4152265], [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685856989&tab=this R_685856989] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_692420222&tab=this R_692420222], held inspected derivatives, 29 October 2026; original entries uninspected.</ref> Preserve the date/year/parish differences; no exact birth-field correction, silent 1784-to-1783 change or multiple-child inference is made.

The inherited 1871 Bridgeton death extract and the possible Mary Glasgon Thomson identification remain unresolved. No adult spouse or children are transferred to this parish child. The existing estimated death about 1871 and Bridgeton field are retained as inherited claims rather than newly proved facts.
